task: feat(ci-runner-governor): a host can be pinned to N slots, live even in a dry run. Interface: `governor.decide(cfg, hosts, runners, waiting, last_action, now, instances=None, pins=None)` takes `pins`, a {host: N} dict, as its eighth positional argument (None or {} means no pin), and still returns [(host, action, runner, verdict, why)]. A pinned host whose verdict is not FULL gets verdict "PINNED" and why "pinned to N, M admitted" (M its admitted runners), and ignores the cooldown and the heat. With more than N admitted it withholds one (the idle runner first, else the busy one nearest its end) unless that would take the pool below `pool_min_admitted`, in which case it holds and why gains "; at the pool floor". With fewer than N admitted and a withheld runner it admits it, even when hot or with nothing queued, unless the pool is at `pool_max_admitted`, in which case it holds. At exactly N it holds. A FULL host keeps its FULL verdict and is withheld as before; an unpinned host is unchanged. Add `read_pins(cfg)` too: {host: N} from each host override key `{"slots": N}`, N a whole number from 0, anything else ignored and logged as "<host>: pin unreadable, ignored: <value>", and pass its result to `decide` in the main loop.
